headline: Updates on Phase 3 and Phase 4 construction, the 1892 Coburn Hall renovation, and the Skanska budget.
summary: Suffolk, Skanska, and PE will report on construction progress, schedules, and summer work. Suffolk will also give an MBE/WBE and workforce update, and Skanska will cover its next steps.
items: Summer Work 2026 schedule completion status update

School Building Committee Meeting 
Meeting Agenda

Time: 6:00 PM 
Location: Mayor’s Reception Room and Zoom

(On-Line; Live Streaming; Or Local Cable Channel (6).  Those

So That You May Be Issued Zoom Link To The Meeting.
